classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in the network with properties like id, position, shape, size, label, and methods to attach/detach edges and update shape or options.

classes.name: Edge
classes.description: Represents a connection between nodes with properties like id, source and target node ids, shape, color, and methods for updating, attaching/detaching, and rendering.

classes.name: DataSet
classes.description: Data structure managing collections of nodes and edges, supports add, update, remove, get, and event subscription methods.

classes.name: shape
classes.description: Various shape classes for node representations, such as circle, box, ellipse, image, etc., each with methods for drawing and calculating distances.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Configure visualization options such as physics, layout, interaction, appearance.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Set nodes and edges data for the network visualization.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Clean up and destroy the network visualization instance.

methods.name: getPositions
methods.description: Retrieve the positions of nodes, optionally within a list of node ids.

methods.name: storePositions
methods.description: Store current node positions, typically to persist layout after manual movement.

methods.name: moveNode
methods.description: Move a specific node to given x, y coordinates.

methods.name: getBoundingBox
methods.description: Get the bounding box of a node by id.

methods.name: getConnectedNodes
methods.description: Get nodes connected to a specific node.

methods.name: getConnectedEdges
methods.description: Get edge ids connected to a node.

methods.name: getScale
methods.description: Get current zoom scale of the network view.

methods.name: getViewPosition
methods.description: Get current view (translation) position.

methods.name: fit
methods.description: Fit the network view to include all nodes.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Move the view to a specified position and scale.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focus the view on specific nodes.

methods.name: releaseNode
methods.description: Release a node from a group or cluster.

methods.name: getOptionsFromConfigurator
methods.description: Retrieve current configuration options set through a visual configurator.

methods.name: selectNodes
methods.description: Select nodes programmatically.

methods.name: selectEdges
methods.description: Select edges programmatically.

methods.name: unselectAll
methods.description: Clear all selections.

methods.name: redraw
methods.description: Redraw the network view.

methods.name: getSelectedNodes
methods.description: Retrieve currently selected nodes.

methods.name: getSelectedEdges
methods.description: Retrieve currently selected edges.
